title: Prose Chunk Payload
description: A semantically bounded slice of a policy, catalog, or handbook document. The only class that goes through vector RAG as its primary path.

heading_path.description: e.g. ['Academic Catalog','Grading','Pass-Fail Option']. Prepended to the embedded text to restore the context chunking destroys.

text.description: Target 300-800 tokens. Never split mid-clause or mid-sentence.

extracted_tables.description: ids of reference-table records lifted out of this section. Tables are NOT left in the embedded text.

defines_terms.description: Terms this chunk authoritatively defines; boosts retrieval for definition questions.
